venue.description: Venue name printed on the ticket.

venueDetail.description: Second ticket line, such as the address.

startDate.description: First day on the strip as an ISO date. Pass it from data so server and client agree.

times.description: Seating times as "HH:MM", in order, shown four to a row. The default runs every half hour from 17:00 to 22:30.

isAvailable.description: Whether a time is free. Everything is free by default.

preferredTime.description: Preselected when free, otherwise the nearest free time, as "HH:MM".

onConfirm.description: Books the table. Resolve to show the booked state, reject to keep the ticket open with an error. Defaults to a short simulated wait.

onStepChange.description: Called on every step, for example to let the page recede while the pill is open.

hourCycle.description: Clock used for displayed times, such as 7:30 PM or 19:30. times, preferredTime, and onConfirm always use "HH:MM".
